description: This file defines the EntityFindOptions class, which encapsulates advanced options for entity search operations in the OFBiz framework. It provides configurable parameters such as result set type, concurrency, fetch size, row limits, and other query customization options.

classes.name: EntityFindOptions
classes.description: A serializable class providing advanced options for entity query operations, including result set type, concurrency, fetch size, row limits, and query modifiers like distinct, limit, and offset.

methods.name: EntityFindOptions
methods.description: Default constructor initializing with default values for find options.

methods.name: EntityFindOptions
methods.description: Parameterized constructor allowing customization of type/concurrency, fetch size, max rows, and distinct flag.

methods.name: EntityFindOptions
methods.description: Convenience constructor setting type/concurrency and distinct flag with default fetch and max rows.

methods.name: getSpecifyTypeAndConcur
methods.description: Returns whether specific type and concurrency settings are used.

methods.name: setSpecifyTypeAndConcur
methods.description: Sets whether specific type and concurrency options will be used.

methods.name: getResultSetType
methods.description: Returns the configured result set type.

methods.name: setResultSetType
methods.description: Sets the result set type for query execution.

methods.name: getResultSetConcurrency
methods.description: Returns the configured result set concurrency mode.

methods.name: setResultSetConcurrency
methods.description: Sets the result set concurrency mode.

methods.name: getFetchSize
methods.description: Returns the fetch size for the query.

methods.name: setFetchSize
methods.description: Sets the fetch size for the query.

methods.name: getMaxRows
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of rows to retrieve.

methods.name: setMaxRows
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of rows to retrieve.

methods.name: getDistinct
methods.description: Returns whether duplicate filtering is enabled.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit value for the query.

methods.name: setLimit
methods.description: Sets the limit value for the query.

methods.name: getOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset value for the query.

methods.name: setOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset value for the query.
